DaypartBounds.description: A field the buyer sets to one of the values the seller allows, `allowed[]`, for a type whose values have no order, such as a geo code or a device category.

DeviceBounds.description: A field the buyer sets to one of the values the seller allows, `allowed[]`, for a type whose values have no order, such as a geo code or a device category.

FrequencyCapPeriod.description: The period a frequency cap counts over. Each term is OpenDirect 2.1's code spelled as the specification spells its terms. `hour`, `day`, `week`, and `month` are calendar periods on the line item's clock, so a `day` runs from midnight to midnight and a count starts again at midnight, not 24 hours after an impression, and a week starts on Monday. `flight`, OpenDirect's `LineDuration`, is no calendar period: it runs from the flight's start to its end, between two calendar dates; The codes of OpenDirect 2.1 Line.frequencyinterval (https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/OpenDirect/blob/82bc294314aba017fc639ba634aecc53adfd675f/OpenDirect.v2.1.final.md#object_line); `hour`: Hour; `day`: Day; `week`: Week; `month`: Month; `flight`: LineDuration

GeoBounds.description: A field the buyer sets to one of the values the seller allows, `allowed[]`, for a type whose values have no order, such as a geo code or a device category.

MaxRange.description: A range of values from `min` to `max`, with at least one bound, such as the bounds within which the buyer sets a frequency cap.
